title: gap_scanner.py's premarket shortlist: does it predict that same day's session?

tables.name: Premarket gap buckets: real vs random control, TRAIN + VAL

notes: Companion to gap_scanner_afterhours_edge_check.py (REJECTED, re-confirmed 2026-08-29 with a larger sample). Covers the genuinely untested half of gap_scanner.py's premise: PREMARKET gap (prior close -> live premarket price at scan time) predicting THAT SAME day's regular session. Different question from gap_universe_calibration.py (full-universe gap measured AT THE OPEN vs accumulation_rank membership) -- this uses gap_scanner's own running premarket snapshot and its own actually-flagged tickers. Reuses gap_scan.json's real git history in the public dashboard repo (cloned fresh at runtime, read-only). Tests both continuation and mean-reversion.

conclusion.summary: Correlation TRAIN=-0.13576906077157555, VAL=0.5200525486604556 (95% CI excludes zero on both, same sign: False). Continuation (HIGH beats LOW) both splits: False. Mean-reversion (LOW beats HIGH) both splits: False. HIGH-gap bucket vs random-shuffle control -- beats it: False, underperforms it: False. No real edge detected in gap_scanner premarket data as currently scoped.
